statement: A batch the Host sent that the chain never answers (a deposit that reverts whole after a good simulation, a dropped transaction, a fee never mined, a gas limit below the requirement) does not wedge the submit path: the sent transaction's receipt is read, and the batch is re-simulated and held or re-sealed, so an urgent op queued behind it (a counter, a reveal) can still go.
source: Review A of PR 141 (not blocking, owed before any Sepolia run); coordinator 10-01 20:49

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival specs take the chain's answer to a batch as given
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model takes the chain's answer to a batch as given
layers.contract: n/a: a deposit batch reverts whole by design (Depository `_revertsWhole`); the duty is the Host's
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk draw that sends a deposit whose allowance moved after the simulation; none is named yet)
layers.ts: owed: e2e builder, in the first step that exercises a failed batch (a receipt read of the sent transaction, then re-simulate and hold or re-seal; no timeout today, and no same-nonce fee bump for a stuck low-fee transaction)

killers.name: R-SUBMIT-WEDGE a deposit that reverts whole after a good simulation does not leave the next fund queued for good
